_comment: This is the single, global entry point for pointing tooling at an authorized local copy
of the original PS2 disc's ZZDATA tree (the directory containing FRONTEND/, GLOBAL/,
CARS/, TRACKS/, LANGUAGES/, MOVIES/, NIS/, SOUND/, __Unknown/). Never hardcode this path
To use it: copy this file to config/ps2_assets.local.json (gitignored) and replace the
'root' value with your own path, OR set the HP2_PS2_ASSET_ROOT environment variable to the
same kind of path instead (the env var always wins over the local config file).
'root' may point either directly at .../GAME/ZZDATA or at its parent; see tools/ps2_assets.py.
Never commit ps2_assets.local.json, extracted asset bytes, or any file under this project's
ignored /local//ps2_decomp//private/ extraction output directories. The original ZZDATA
contents are proprietary game data, not project source.
